notes.title: v0.5.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with builds freezing.

Adjusted the algorithm for auto-distribution of build characteristics; now there will be stricter adherence to perks.

Added an additional option to builds that will stop the distribution of points if the build no longer contains a sequence.

Fixed a game crash when numbers take on an undefined value.

The rarity increase mechanic now does not require a large number of identical items depending on rarity.

The rarity limit in the game has been increased.

An additional option has been added for auto potions, which will allow you to drink ambrosia up to a specified area.

notes.title: 0.5.0 QoL, Sorting, Automation, Increasing Rarity
notes.content:
Added mechanics for increasing the rarity of items. You can increase rarity when processing minerals in the  submenu.

Added a hero build menu that allows you to automate the leveling of skills, perks, characteristics, and weapon techniques. Feature opens after 5 rituals. For those who already have 5 or more rituals, 1 more rebirth ritual is required.

Added an auto potion menu that allows you to set potions to be used automatically.

Added automation for summoning minions.

Added a notation switch in the options.

Added an  submenu in the options, which allows you to customize various aspects of the game.

Added inventory sorting.

The rarity of items in the store corresponds to your progress in the game and can reach 10.

Adjusted boss behavior so that they cannot be taken outside the zone.

You can smoke Ledum to reset all nodes in the Threads of Fate and redistribute them.

Changed the effect of knot 2 of the Pilgrim thread.

Chaos bones are now reset to the required amount after the ritual so that health does not go into the negative.

The effect of the Chop technique for bosses and possessed characters has been changed.

Auto-clicks can now collect loot upon contact with it.

Loot will be collected automatically if there is more than 100 pieces on the screen.

Items in the inventory can be added to favorites. To do this, click on the heart in the right corner of the cell.

Auto Blacksmith has been improved. The number of levels that can be raised is tied to the maximum possible level increase for the item with the available gold.

Now, when switching between x1/x10/x100/MAX modes, the amount of gold next to the weapon will be displayed, which is how much will be spent on raising the level.

The Auto Blacksmith sound has been removed.

Bats no longer drop eggs.

Fixed the damage of the ghost pickaxe, summoned through the genius in the Threads of Fate.

Removed the limit from the gift chest scale in the alchemist's shop.

 and  in the store have been changed to the  bonus.
The  bonus adds one point per hero level to both combat skills and crafts. 
A limit of 10 levels has been set for improving this bonus.
The price of upgrading  in the Alchemist's Shop has been increased.
For players who have upgraded beyond the limit, the bonus will be reduced to the limit, and the spent Ledum and Mercury will be returned.

We made this decision in order to balance the Combat and Crafting branches.
The previous division tilted the game too much towards crafting.

Fixed a bug where runes were not displayed when opening the Chaos Chest.

God phenomena will be available after the first island storyline to achieve the achievement.(if for some reason it was not received)

Changed explanation for transmutation.

The animation of the Wave has been adjusted.

The formula for the rune technique Reduce Mana Cost has been changed.

notes.title: v0.4.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where Gaze of destiny points were awarded not only for completing an island, but also for completing a location. Knots have been reset, points should be redistributed.

Added mechanics for moving between explored islands.

Rings now have symbols.

Added a note to the wizardy window stating that the  sigil interferes with summoning.

Fixed a game crash related to skill improvement.

notes.title: v0.3.7
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where mana cost and rune power did not change after upgrading the rune's technique level.

Fixed a bug where the location reward subscription was valid for 7 days instead of 14. Those who purchased it and it has expired or is still valid will have it extended.

Fixed a bug where, when mooring to an island, a location was selected that did not match the type of the island's first location.

notes.title: v0.3.6
notes.content:
Prices in mercury and ledum have been returned.

The potion of the past costs and functions as before, except that it does not revive the possessed.

Fixed a disassembly error.

notes.title: v0.3.5
notes.content:
The health of the minions depends not only on their spirit, but also on the health of the hero. 

Minions have their own armor class/absorption, which also depends on the hero's armor class/absorption.

Minion description in the arcana of invocation menu contains damage, health, and armor class/absorption stats that minions will have when summoned.

You can now invest 5 and 10 skill points using the right mouse button or holding down Shift, or invest all points by holding down Ctrl.

Now, in Mineral Processing in disassembly mode, you can extract a sphere from an item.

 and  quests give 12 ledum instead of 8.

The  item has been added to the game menu.

Hero levels starting from level 12 are now achieved using a new formula.

Mining adds 2% to ore search instead of 10%.

Herbalism adds 2% to herb search instead of 5%.

The prices of upgrades in the Alchemist and Awakened shops are calculated using a new formula.

Return Potion returns you 1 zone back and additionally requires 10 ledum.

Calculation of the hero's attack speed and running speed has been adjusted.

, , and  perks add 3% to the power of blessings instead of 25%.

 perk increases blessings by 50% per level instead of 100%.

 perk speeds up by 20% for 10 seconds instead of 50% for 3 minutes.

, , and  techniques now have limits.

The effects of Mushroom Tea and Flower Tea now have limits.

The effect of Herbal Tea lasts 15 seconds instead of one minute.

 perk now has a limit.

Slight increase in damage for all bosses and health for chaos fiends.

Fixed a bug with the negative effect of the  perk, and reduced the slowdown increase per level.

Sphere of Techniques no longer gives 1 level for rune techniques, but works similarly to inserting a sphere into a weapon.

Added sounds for picking up potions from the ground.

Added update information and reward for reading it.

Adjusted loot behavior when picking up items.

The drop rates for items in the Rich сhest have been changed.

notes.title: v0.3.4
notes.content:
\[EN] Adjusted text for the Handy with a shield skill.

Fixed a bug where it was possible to brew potions without sufficient Potion brewing skill.

Increased ore gain depending on location.

Adjusted enemy health depending on location.

Added offline reward.

Added a new type of zone - Coast.

Force of the rune Brook has been adjusted.

notes.title: v0.3.3 day one patch
notes.content:
Now, when upgrading weapons, the correct amount of gold is taken.

Fixed a game crash when activating the Redmoon technique on weapons.

Fixed a bug where the Steam achievement Religious II was earned together with the Hunter II achievement.

The health of summoned creatures has been reduced.

A restriction has been added for loading saves from the demo version.

\[EN] The description of the Magic Trap technique has been corrected.

Two screen resolutions have been added for small screen formats.

The description of enchantments related to melee weapons has been corrected.

Fixed a game crash when playing with the Stone Barrier rune.

The placement of locations on the island map has been corrected for large islands.

Fixed a bug where the Blood Potion allowed you to kill ordinary enemies almost guaranteed.

notes.title: Dev Notes: Weapons
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is the Illegal Turtle team here!
Gothic Clicker is coming out on August 22nd, and in order not to waste any time, we decided to release “developer notes” in the form of articles so that you can familiarize yourself with some of the features and lore before the release.
We will try to post interesting articles after each development cycle.
Join our new community in Discord to follow the project and help in its creation:
https://discord.gg/rnCStXCNmS

Our first article is dedicated to WEAPONS.

The game will have the following types of weapons:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/83583f33751b3d11760bc59de884c56c21b6a106.pngSwords - balanced weapons. Moderately strong and fast. For those who like stability.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/683443ead15dbb2c951dc532b35b970ae39605c7.pngMaces - heavy weapons. Slow attacks, but crushing. A competent approach will allow you to win in 1 blow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/f3941b99c819f9b5cc98b84c08725b35944b101c.pngAxes - a weapon for active players who like to click. Speed is slightly lower than swords, and damage is slightly higher.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/d73853aa933620dcdd9a2db6e4d12c989cce9af0.pngBows are the weapon of hunters. Allows you to effectively hunt game and kill enemies at a distance, before they even reach you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/3841e260c0fea7e742dbebb92db4af397ec07b22.pngShields - protects against enemy damage and can complement weapons. Some mages will also do well with a shield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/d6a9071d15a213ead3f758b5b9320d231d29bff9.pngRunes - a magical weapon that works independently and does not require the attention of your hero. Very effective, but requires the appropriate skills.

Melee weapons are one-handed and two-handed. 
One-handed weapons can also be combined with other one-handed weapons, or with a shield. 
In total in the game (at the moment) more than 100 types of different weapons. 
Each weapon has its own original name, appearance, set of characteristics and techniques. 

Techniques
Each weapon has two techniques.
Techniques are special abilities that are inherent to the selected weapon.
Below we can see Guard using “Geyser” technique with the hammer, and militiaman using Starfall technique with a bow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/32b09b852763b859764715175c683cc25c63077d.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/3f0233b0ab14d1845a1115edda4173f4b411ea48.gif
There are magic techniques like this!
There are also quite classic techniques (“Powerful blow”, “Blow with a swing”).
Some of the techniques support active play when you want to click more (“Angry strike”, “Aiming”).
There are also those aimed at the idle side of the game. For example, the “auto-hunt” technique on some bows, which allows you to hunt automatically.

Ore Processing

You have the Philosopher's Stone, a magical artifact that allows you to upgrade your weapons for gold right during combat and pump up your techniques. But gold alone will not be enough to increase the effectiveness of your weapons by an order of magnitude.
The best way to increase the quality of your weapons is by processing ore, but you'll need a variety of minerals, that you encounter along the way. The experience of an ore miner from a previous life will help you figure out what's what!
You can also dismantle weapons you already have for minerals.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/0baeebf872e27e61f3c8f572a628b86630db09e7.gif
You can also spend minerals to create spheres.
Spheres are inserted into free slots and give the item magical properties.
We can say that spheres are universal techniques that can be used to enchant any weapon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/95fb649255cd03334c5f60c28927c7cf2d8a4c15.gif

We will probably stop here.
Like this post if you found it interesting and follow Gothic Clicker so you don't miss out on new posts!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/08b891ce60abb17b890444ab4bd986445920c979.png
In the next article we will tell you about the history of the world of the game, and what the hero will face on his difficult path in the kingdom of Elderath.
